name: verify-broken-repo
description: Tiny fixture used by examples/verify-broken-repo.sh to demonstrate KirkForge's end-to-end correction loop on a known-broken TypeScript project. The fixture intentionally contains 3 bugs: (1) a type error, (2) a shell-injection lint rule violation, (3) a broken internal import (graph broken-edge). Running the demo with `tsc` installed should produce an overall FAIL packet with all three bugs visible in the JSON output.
